title: 银行与金融精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 我的账单上有一笔我不认识的扣款。
items.en: There's a charge on my statement that I don't recognise.
answers: There's a charge on my statement that I don't recognise.
There is a charge on my statement that I do not recognise.
There's a charge on my statement that I do not recognise.
items.notes: statement 指账户账单；charge 指一笔收费或扣款，that 从句修饰 charge。

items.zh: 这笔转账通常需要多久才能到账？
items.en: How long does this transfer usually take to reach the recipient's account?
answers: How long does this transfer usually take to reach the recipient's account?
items.notes: take + 时间 + to do；recipient 表示收款人。

items.zh: 在我确认付款之前，您能说明全部手续费吗？
items.en: Could you explain all the fees before I confirm the payment?
answers: Could you explain all the fees before I confirm the payment?
items.notes: before 引出确认付款的时点；fees 用复数表示各项费用。

items.zh: 即使余额不足，这笔自动扣款也会继续执行吗？
items.en: Will this direct debit still go through even if my balance is insufficient?
answers: Will this direct debit still go through even if my balance is insufficient?
items.notes: go through 表示成功执行；even if 引出假设性让步。

items.zh: 我想冻结这张卡，因为我找不到它了。
items.en: I'd like to freeze this card because I can't find it.
answers: I'd like to freeze this card because I can't find it.
I would like to freeze this card because I cannot find it.
I'd like to freeze this card because I cannot find it.
items.notes: freeze a card 表示暂停卡的使用；because 说明请求原因。

items.zh: 自从设定了每月预算，我就更容易看清钱花在了哪里。
items.en: Since setting a monthly budget, I've found it easier to see where my money goes.
answers: Since setting a monthly budget, I've found it easier to see where my money goes.
Since setting a monthly budget, I have found it easier to see where my money goes.
items.notes: find it + 形容词 + to do 中 it 为形式宾语；where 从句说明支出去向。

items.zh: 我关心的是总还款额，而不只是每月要还多少。
items.en: What matters to me is the total amount repayable, not just the monthly instalment.
answers: What matters to me is the total amount repayable, not just the monthly instalment.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；amount repayable 指应偿还总额。

items.zh: 如果我提前还清贷款，是否需要支付额外费用？
items.en: Would I have to pay an extra fee if I repaid the loan early?
answers: Would I have to pay an extra fee if I repaid the loan early?
items.notes: would 搭配 if + 过去式，礼貌询问假设情境；repay 表示偿还。

items.zh: 这张收据显示付款成功，但商家说还没有收到钱。
items.en: The receipt shows that the payment went through, but the merchant says the funds haven't arrived.
answers: The receipt shows that the payment went through, but the merchant says the funds haven't arrived.
The receipt shows that the payment went through, but the merchant says the funds have not arrived.
items.notes: went through 表示交易已完成；资金未到账用现在完成时。

items.zh: 请把新的通讯地址更新到我的账户里。
items.en: Please update the mailing address on my account.
answers: Please update the mailing address on my account.
items.notes: update + 宾语表示更新；on my account 指账户记录上的信息。

items.zh: 与其只看宣传的利率，我更想了解这项产品有哪些限制。
items.en: Rather than focus only on the advertised interest rate, I'd like to understand the restrictions on this product.
answers: Rather than focus only on the advertised interest rate, I'd like to understand the restrictions on this product.
items.notes: advertised 是过去分词定语；restrictions on 表示针对某产品的限制。

items.zh: 能否给我一份书面确认，说明这项定期付款已经取消？
items.en: Could I have written confirmation that this recurring payment has been cancelled?
answers: Could I have written confirmation that this recurring payment has been cancelled?
items.notes: that 从句说明 confirmation 的内容；has been cancelled 是现在完成时被动。

items.zh: 我需要开一个不用保持最低余额的账户。
items.en: I need an account without a minimum balance requirement.
answers: I need an account without a minimum balance requirement.

items.zh: 这张卡在国外使用时会收取货币兑换费吗？
items.en: Will this card incur a currency conversion fee when used abroad?
answers: Will this card incur a currency conversion fee when used abroad?

items.zh: 收款人的名字和账户上的名字必须完全一致吗？
items.en: Does the recipient's name have to match the account name exactly?
answers: Does the recipient's name have to match the account name exactly?

items.zh: 我输错了转账金额，这笔交易还能撤回吗？
items.en: I entered the wrong transfer amount; can the transaction still be reversed?
answers: I entered the wrong transfer amount; can the transaction still be reversed?

items.zh: 为什么这笔付款仍显示为待处理？
items.en: Why is this payment still showing as pending?
answers: Why is this payment still showing as pending?

items.zh: 请将每日转账限额调低。
items.en: Please lower my daily transfer limit.
answers: Please lower my daily transfer limit.

items.zh: 自动取款机没有吐出现金，却显示已经扣款。
items.en: The cash machine did not dispense any money, but my account shows a debit.
answers: The cash machine did not dispense any money, but my account shows a debit.
The cash machine didn't dispense any money, but my account shows a debit.

items.zh: 我能在手机上下载上个月的对账单吗？
items.en: Can I download last month's statement on my phone?
answers: Can I download last month's statement on my phone?

items.zh: 这张支票需要多久才能完成清算？
items.en: How long will this cheque take to clear?
answers: How long will this cheque take to clear?

items.zh: 通知说验证失败，但没有指出哪项信息有误。
items.en: The notice says verification failed without identifying which information was incorrect.
answers: The notice says verification failed without identifying which information was incorrect.

items.zh: 我想为房租设置每月固定转账。
items.en: I would like to set up a monthly standing order for the rent.
answers: I would like to set up a monthly standing order for the rent.
I'd like to set up a monthly standing order for the rent.
items.notes: standing order：定期定额转账指令。

items.zh: 更换银行卡之后，我需要重新设置哪些付款？
items.en: Which payments do I need to update after replacing my card?
answers: Which payments do I need to update after replacing my card?

items.zh: 您能解释账面余额和可用余额为什么不同吗？
items.en: Could you explain why my ledger balance differs from my available balance?
answers: Could you explain why my ledger balance differs from my available balance?

items.zh: 这笔临时预授权预计什么时候解除？
items.en: When is this temporary authorisation hold expected to be released?
answers: When is this temporary authorisation hold expected to be released?

items.zh: 我收到一条要求提供验证码的信息，想核实是不是银行发的。
items.en: I received a request for a verification code and want to check whether it came from the bank.
answers: I received a request for a verification code and want to check whether it came from the bank.

items.zh: 在确认收款人之前，我不会再次付款。
items.en: I will not make another payment until the recipient has been verified.
answers: I will not make another payment until the recipient has been verified.
I'll not make another payment until the recipient has been verified.

items.zh: 我们想开联名账户，但需要了解各自的操作权限。
items.en: We want a joint account but need to understand each person's authority to use it.
answers: We want a joint account but need to understand each person's authority to use it.

items.zh: 这项优惠利率会持续多久？
items.en: How long will this promotional interest rate last?
answers: How long will this promotional interest rate last?

items.zh: 如果利率上调，我的月供会如何变化？
items.en: How would my monthly repayments change if the interest rate increased?
answers: How would my monthly repayments change if the interest rate increased?
items.notes: would 配合 if 过去式。

items.zh: 我希望把到期日调整到发薪日之后。
items.en: I would like to move the due date to after payday.
answers: I would like to move the due date to after payday.
I'd like to move the due date to after payday.

items.zh: 我可以把收据作为这笔支出的证明吗？
items.en: Can I use the receipt as evidence of this expense?
answers: Can I use the receipt as evidence of this expense?
items.notes: use A as B：用作证明。

items.zh: 这项服务按每笔交易收费，还是收取固定月费？
items.en: Does this service charge per transaction or apply a fixed monthly fee?
answers: Does this service charge per transaction or apply a fixed monthly fee?

items.zh: 预算里要留出一部分钱，应付不定期发生的开销。
items.en: Part of the budget needs to be set aside for irregular expenses.
answers: Part of the budget needs to be set aside for irregular expenses.

items.zh: 关闭账户之前，请确认所有待处理交易都已完成。
items.en: Before closing the account, please confirm that all pending transactions have been completed.
answers: Before closing the account, please confirm that all pending transactions have been completed.
